title: Alien vs. Predator
note: Capcom CPS2 action game: health, health_p2, time, lives, lives_p2, power, power_p2, 4 characters (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS work RAM from 0xFF0000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x65 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Health PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x65 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Health PL2)

lives.note: lives (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL1)

lives_p2.note: lives of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL2)

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0xE4 (FBNeo cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in %, full = 0xE4 (FBNeo cheat database)

_p1_chr.note: player 1 character (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL1)

_p2_chr.note: player 2 or computer character (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL2)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move
